The events that listeners receive, with the bus, the types and the priorities that order the listeners of a node or a UI.
Learn: [Events](/use/learn/interactivity/events/), [Node lifecycle](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/node-lifecycle/).

## Main types

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Event`](/reference/events/event/) | class | The base class of every event that a listener receives. |
| [`NodeAnimateEvent`](/reference/events/nodeanimateevent/) | class | The event of `onAnimate`, with the animator of a node and the value it reached on this frame. |
| [`NodeChangeEvent`](/reference/events/nodechangeevent/) | class | The change of a value of a node, with the value before and the value after, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`. |
| [`NodeCharEvent`](/reference/events/nodecharevent/) | class | The event of `handleCharTyped` on a node, with one typed character as a Unicode code point. |
| [`NodeChildEvent`](/reference/events/nodechildevent/) | class | The event of `onChildAppend`, with the child added to a node. |
| [`NodeDragEvent`](/reference/events/nodedragevent/) | class | A step of the drag of a node, with its drop target, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`. |
| [`NodeDrawEvent`](/reference/events/nodedrawevent/) | class | The event of `onDraw` and `onRender`, with the position of the pointer on the frame being drawn. |
| [`NodeEvent`](/reference/events/nodeevent/) | class | An event about a node, and the event of the node events that carry nothing else, such as `onInit` or `onDetach`. |
| [`NodeFieldChangeEvent`](/reference/events/nodefieldchangeevent/) | class | The change of the text of a field, with the text before and after and the value read from it, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`. |
| [`NodeHoverEvent`](/reference/events/nodehoverevent/) | class | The event of `onHoverStart`, `onHover` and `onHoverEnd`, with the position of the pointer. |
| [`NodeInputEvent`](/reference/events/nodeinputevent/) | class | The base class of the input events of a node, which a listener consumes to stop the input. |
| [`NodeKeyEvent`](/reference/events/nodekeyevent/) | class | The event of `handleKeyPressed` and `handleKeyReleased` on a node, with the key that the layout names and its place on the keyboard. |
| [`NodeMouseEvent`](/reference/events/nodemouseevent/) | class | The event of a press, a release, a drag or a click on a node, with the position of the pointer and the button. |
| [`NodeMouseScrollEvent`](/reference/events/nodemousescrollevent/) | class | The event of `handleMouseScroll` on a node, with the position of the pointer and the turn of the wheel. |
| [`NodeProgressEvent`](/reference/events/nodeprogressevent/) | class | The event of `onProgress` on a resource player, with the progress of the playback. |
| [`NodeReorderEvent`](/reference/events/nodereorderevent/) | class | A move of a child in a reorderable list, with the child and its index before and after, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`. |
| [`NodeScrollEvent`](/reference/events/nodescrollevent/) | class | A change of the scroll of a node on one axis, with the offset before and after, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`. |
| [`NodeWatchEvent`](/reference/events/nodewatchevent/) | class | The event of `onWatch`, which fires after a watch of a node applied its properties. |
| [`UIChangeEvent`](/reference/events/uichangeevent/) | class | The change of a value of a UI, with the value before and the value after, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`. |
| [`UICharEvent`](/reference/events/uicharevent/) | class | The event of `handleCharTyped` on a UI, with one typed character that no node consumed, as a Unicode code point. |
| [`UICloseEvent`](/reference/events/uicloseevent/) | class | The closing of a UI, in a cancellable `Pre` before it starts and a `Post` once the UI is closed. |
| [`UIEvent`](/reference/events/uievent/) | class | The base class of the events about a UI, such as its input or its closing. |
| [`UIInputEvent`](/reference/events/uiinputevent/) | class | The base class of the input events of a UI, which a listener consumes to stop the input. |
| [`UIKeyEvent`](/reference/events/uikeyevent/) | class | The event of `handleKeyPressed` and `handleKeyReleased` on a UI, with the key that the layout names and its place on the keyboard. |
| [`UIMouseEvent`](/reference/events/uimouseevent/) | class | The event of a press, a release or a drag on a UI, with the position of the pointer and the button. |
| [`UIMouseScrollEvent`](/reference/events/uimousescrollevent/) | class | The event of `handleMouseScroll` on a UI, with the position of the pointer and the turn of the wheel that no node consumed. |

## Related types

The interfaces, enums and helper classes of this family that the main types use.

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`EventBus`](/reference/events/eventbus/) | class | Holds the listeners of an object, one ordered list per event type, and runs them when an event fires. |
| [`EventPriority`](/reference/events/eventpriority/) | enum | The order in which the listeners of one event run, from `HIGHEST` to `LOWEST`, then `MONITOR`. |
| [`EventType`](/reference/events/eventtype/) | class | The key of one kind of event in an event bus, such as the click of a node. |
| [`ICancellableEvent`](/reference/events/icancellableevent/) | interface | An event that a listener cancels to refuse the change it announces. |
| [`IConsumableEvent`](/reference/events/iconsumableevent/) | interface | An input event that a listener consumes to stop it. |

## Supporting types

Nested types, callbacks and listeners that the main types use.

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`EventListener`](/reference/events/eventlistener/) | interface | A function that JOID calls with an event, written as a lambda, with a priority that orders it among the other listeners. |
| [`NodeChangeEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodechangeevent-post/) | class | The event of an `onX` listener of a node, which fires once a value changed. |
| [`NodeChangeEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodechangeevent-pre/) | class | The event of a `beforeX` listener of a node, which can refuse the change it announces. |
| [`NodeDragEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodedragevent-post/) | class | The event of `onDragStart`, `onDrag`, `onDragDrop` and `onDragSnap`, which fires once a step of a drag happened. |
| [`NodeDragEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodedragevent-pre/) | class | The event of `beforeDragStart` and `beforeDragDrop`, which can refuse the start or the drop of a drag. |
| [`NodeFieldChangeEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodefieldchangeevent-post/) | class | The event of `onChange` on a field, which fires once its text changed. |
| [`NodeFieldChangeEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodefieldchangeevent-pre/) | class | The event of `beforeChange` on a field, which can refuse an edit. |
| [`NodeReorderEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodereorderevent-post/) | class | The event of `onReorderStart`, `onReorder` and `onReorderEnd`, which fires once a step of a reorder happened. |
| [`NodeReorderEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodereorderevent-pre/) | class | The event of `beforeReorder`, which can refuse a new place of the dragged child. |
| [`NodeScrollEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodescrollevent-post/) | class | The event of `onScroll`, `onScrollToEnd` and `onScrollEndReached`, which fires once a node scrolled. |
| [`NodeScrollEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodescrollevent-pre/) | class | The event of `beforeScroll`, which can refuse a scroll of a node. |
| [`UIChangeEvent.Post`](/reference/events/uichangeevent-post/) | class | The event of an `onX` listener of a UI, which fires once a value of the UI changed. |
| [`UIChangeEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/uichangeevent-pre/) | class | The event of a `beforeX` listener of a UI, which can refuse the change it announces. |
| [`UICloseEvent.Post`](/reference/events/uicloseevent-post/) | class | The event of `onClose`, which fires once a UI is closed. |
| [`UICloseEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/uicloseevent-pre/) | class | The event of `beforeClose`, which can keep a UI open. |
